name: cc-report
description: A report button under each answer: a fork of the main thread rewrites the answer as a short, sourced report in a side pane, reusing the prompt cache and leaving the conversation untouched.

language.title: Report language
language.description: The language reports are written in: a code (ko, ja, es) or a name. Empty: Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale, else English.
